label: Custom reviewDimensions make all_dimensions_clean unreachable AND disable the review pivot: buildDimensionCoverage only writes the 4 REQUIRED_DIMENSIONS keys (reduce-state.cjs:1225-1247), while convergence computes missingDimensions over config.reviewDimensions (convergence.cjs:1540-1556); a custom dimension can never be covered, cleanReviewStop (:1106-1111) never fires, and the adapter throws on any triggerReason !== 'all_dimensions_clean' (divergent-review-pivot.ts:338-340). New defect beyond D1-D9.

Review has no question surface: no inbox/keyQuestions/openQuestions anywhere in reduce-state.cjs; coverage universe is reviewDimensions normalized once at init (deep-review.yaml:645). Gen-1's inbox.jsonl frontier-admission design is research-only; the growable review surfaces are searchDebt, candidateCoverage, ruledOutCandidates, cleanSearchProof, traceability.results — the set buildCandidateSeeds mines. A review frontier sub-mode needs a dimension/candidate admission surface, not an inbox.

Review nextFocus chain repeats the D5 free-text hijack: latest iteration-file 'Recommended Next Focus' free text wins over the first-uncovered REQUIRED_DIMENSION fallback (reduce-state.cjs:2184-2186), then divergence.currentFocus overrides (:2187-2189), then a most-recent blocked-stop pins recovery text (:2198-2215); the pivot re-reads previousFocus from that same strategy section (divergent-review-pivot.ts:355-356).

Review pivot seeds are closed and re-derivational — 5 sources only: unswept config.reviewDimensions, registry.searchDebt, v2-ledger method gaps (producer_consumer_trace, negative_test_inspection, gated on reviewDepthSchemaVersion===2), non-pass traceability.results (divergent-review-pivot.ts:203-289). Boundary regexes (:172-184) and all 3 seat mandates (:398-402) forbid target expansion; the pivot can re-sweep obligations but never widen. Custom dimensions yield a permanent unswept-dimension seed each pivot.

fanout-merge drops every coverage surface: merged registry = openFindings/resolvedFindings/findingsBySeverity/searchDebt/failedRequiredGateIds/mergedVerdict only (fanout-merge.cjs:981-996); dimensionCoverage, traceability, searchCoverage, candidateCoverage, divergence, ruledOutCandidates never read. Gen-1's merge-time coverage guard has no coverage map to read; a frontier_scope partition cannot express per-lineage coverage today. Mechanics: only active findings merge (:894); resolved suppressed while active elsewhere (:917-919); dedup by findingId||title + optional title-token near-dup (:344-398); canonical = highest SEVERITY_RANK (:587-617); searchDebt unioned by bugClass||id first-wins (:945-955); verdict via deriveReviewVerdict strongest-restriction (:958-964).

Review prompt pack exposes frontier only as pivot-candidate frontier: render_prompt_pack at deep-review.yaml:1450; every 'frontier' hit binds to the adapter's persisted candidate frontier (:1239, :1289-1290) or reducer-rendered divergence output (:2098); no frontier_proposal/expansive wiring exists in the yaml. Gen-1's leaf-proposal delta row was specified for the research pack only — the review pack needs the same channel added. Partially verified: pack body not read in full, but the frontier grep enumeration covers the mechanism.
